blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Representatives of the Balatoc Indigenous community on Tuesday called on the National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP) to look into a mining company’s alleged failure to deliver on its social and economic commitments to its host community. Representatives of the Balatoc Indigenous Cultural Community (ICC), in their demand, cited the memorandum of agreement (MOA) signed by the Makilala Mining Company, Inc. (MMCI) for the Maalinao-Caigutan-Biyog (MCB) Copper-Gold Project as approved by the NCIP commission en banc on Sept. 4, 2024. Under the agreement, the MMCI is required to provide employment and livelihood opportunities, infrastructure development, health and wellness […]...
